DROP VIEW [EDS].[V_WMG_CRM_CUSTOMERS]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE VIEW [EDS].[V_WMG_CRM_CUSTOMERS] AS WITH Rolling_Window AS
(
SELECT * FROM
    (
    SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Business_Day_Flag ORDER BY FULLDATE DESC) AS RN
    ,* 
    FROM eds.DATE_DIM
        INNER JOIN eds.EDS_CTL
            ON FULLDATE <= CRM_DATE
    WHERE Business_Day_Flag = 'Y'
    ) A
--WHERE
--- Last n business days
--    RN <= Rolling_Window
--	RN <= 1
)
SELECT
--RW.FullDate AS asofDate,
RW.FullDate AS asofDate,
NULL AS modifiedDate,
CRM_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ID AS BANK_ID,
CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY AS cifNumber,
CRM_ACCOUNTS.Name AS customerName,
CRM_ACCOUNTS.CUST_FIRST_NAME AS firstName,
CRM_ACCOUNTS.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME AS middleName,
CRM_ACCOUNTS.CUST_LAST_NAME AS lastName,
CRM_ACCOUNTS.NAMESUFFIX AS suffix,
CRM_ACCOUNTS.Cust_DOB AS birthDate,
EDF.ACCT_NAME AS accountName,
EDF.FORACID_UNMASKED AS accountNumber,
EDA.acct_poa_as_rec_type relationType,
EDA.cust_reltn_code relationCode,
CRM_ACCOUNTS.struserfield13 rmAssigned,
EDF.sol_id branch,
EDF.dep_account_status accountStatus,
EDF.ACCT_OPN_DATE AS accountcreationDate
FROM Rolling_Window AS RW
    LEFT JOIN eds.Customer_Dim AS CRM_ACCOUNTS
        ON CRM_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
        AND SUBSTRING(CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY, 1, 1) = 'R'
        AND RW.FullDate BETWEEN CRM_ACCOUNTS.SCD_Start_Date AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.SCD_End_Date
	LEFT JOIN EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA
		ON EDA.CUST_ID = CRM_ACCOUNTS.CORE_CUST_ID
		AND EDA.BANK_ID = CRM_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ID
		AND EDA.del_flg='N'
		AND RW.FullDate = EDA.AS_OF_DATE
	LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF
		ON EDA.ACID = EDF.GAM_ACID
		AND EDA.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
		AND EDF.del_flg='N'
		AND RW.FullDate = EDF.AS_OF_DATE

	WHERE	
		CRM_ACCOUNTS.ACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL
		AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.struserfield13 IS NOT NULL;
GO
